hero.caption: The Hospitium in Museum gardens York, England. The ground floor date from around 1300, but the upper storey has been extensively restored in modern times. The ruined gateway on the left side dates from the 15th century, and was probably the entrance to a passage that ran towards the water-gate by the river.
hero.alt: The Hospitium in Museum gardens York, England. The ground floor date from around 1300, but the upper storey has been extensively restored in modern times. images.caption: Part of a set of newly carved gargoyle figures created as part of the currently ongoing major restoration of the east facade of York Minster.
